jobs.occupation: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) - Start Date: 1 October 2026 (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Für unsere
zukünftige Fab in Dresden suchen wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und
engagierte/n: Equipment Engineer (m/f/d) – Start Date: 1 October
2026 At ESMC, the Equipment Engineer supports the installation,
maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of advanced
semiconductor manufacturing equipment in a cleanroom environment. As
part of a high-volume 24/7 fab operation, the role focuses on ensuring
tool performance, improving uptime, reducing defects, and supporting
stable production. The position requires openness to scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty, includes an initial induction and
training period in Dresden of one month, followed by one year of
on-the-job training in Taiwan. If you are interested in advancing your
career in semiconductor manufacturing, learning from one of the
world’s leading semiconductor companies, and joining an
international and diverse team on a unique learning journey, apply now
with your English CV. Tasks 1. Maintain equipment performance in a
cleanroom environment to support stable, high-quality production. 2.
Handle on-duty tasks and perform fundamental alarm troubleshooting. 3.
Install and qualify new tool sets according to project plans and
schedules. 4. Identify root causes and solve critical equipment
issues. 5. Improve tool uptime and availability while driving defect
reduction. 6. Identify and pursue opportunities for hardware
capability enhancement. 7. Build defense and monitoring systems to
prevent equipment failures and performance loss. 8. Manage vendor
relationships and act as module liaison with facilities, vendors, and
manufacturing shift personnel. 9. Support scheduled night shifts,
evening shifts, weekend work, on-duty assignments, and on-call duties
as required in a 24/7 high-volume manufacturing environment. Profile

1. Legally eligible to work in Germany. 2. Available for approximately
one year of on-the-job training in Taiwan. 3. Open for scheduled and
occasional shift work, on call duty. 4. Degree in electronics,
electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechanics,
mechatronics, material engineering, or an equivalent field. 5.
Practical experience in a mechanical or equipment-related field. 6.
Understanding of technical documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge
of semiconductor manufacturing is a plus. 8. Fluent in English with
good command of German. 9. Hands-on working attitude with an open
mindset. 10. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 11. Able
to perform physical work on tools in a cleanroom environment.
Important Candidate Information: Start Date: This role is planned to
commence on October 1, 2026, in Dresden. Depending on your needs and
timeline preferences, January 1, 2027, can be considered as an
alternative start date. Onboarding and International Training: The
first month of your employment will be spent in Dresden. Following
this initial onboarding, training, and integration with your new team
members, you will travel to Taiwan for a one-year on-the-job training
and knowledge transfer program. Your training in Taiwan will involve
close collaboration with experienced TSMC engineering teams. You may
also receive additional training and support at TSMC’s
state-of-the-art Newcomer Training Center in Taichung. Training
Logistics: For employees requiring accommodation during the first
month in Dresden, and who reside more than 90 minutes away, ESMC will
organize appropriate temporary lodging. This provision does not apply
to employees who establish a residential address in Dresden (e.g., to
expedite work permit procedures away from their original place of
residence) or who terminate a personal lease contract in Dresden prior
to their planned departure to Taiwan. Furthermore, ESMC will organize
and provide air and ground transportation from Dresden to Taichung
(Taiwan) and back at the conclusion of the training. Accommodation in
Taiwan will be provided in one of TSMC’s modern and comfortable
company dormitories. Role Requirements and Expectations: This is a
unique opportunity to gain exposure to TSMC’s world-leading advanced
manufacturing practices and actively contribute to building ESMC from
the ground up. As a start-up organization, ESMC offers the opportunity
to play an active role in shaping the company’s culture, future
organization and ways of working. Candidates should be comfortable in
a dynamic environment where certain operational details such as
processes, documentation, shift structures, will continue to evolve
during the ramp-up phase. This role is ideal for individuals with a
strong growth mindset, a positive attitude, and a long-term
perspective. We offer Jede Reise beginnt mit dem ersten Schritt. Der
Einstieg bei ESMC zu diesem frühen Zeitpunkt bietet Ihnen die
einzigartige Gelegenheit, aktiv die Zukunft des Werks in Dresden
mitzugestalten, Ihre Karriere voranzutreiben und Ihr wahres Potenzial
unter Beweis zu stellen. Der Einstieg bei ESMC zu diesem frühen
Zeitpunkt bietet Ihnen die einzigartige Gelegenheit, aktiv die Zukunft
des Werks in Dresden mitzugestalten, Ihre Karriere voranzutreiben und
Ihr wahres Potenzial unter Beweis zu stellen. Sie werden in einem

des größten und fortschrittlichsten Halbleiterherstellers der Welt,
TSMC, haben. Sie haben reichlich Gelegenheit, mehr über die

jobs.description:
The chemical industry is one of the world's growth sectors with a
promising future. The TALKE Group is one of the leading specialist
logistics providers serving the chemical and petrochemical industries.
Companies across Europe, the Gulf States, India, China, and the United
States rely on the performance and expertise of our 4,300
transportation and logistics specialists. AS DIVERSE AS IT IS

the number one solution partner for the chemical industry and to set
new standards in logistics. Would you like to be part of our journey
and contribute your pioneering spirit, experience, and passion? Then
we look forward to receiving your application! Verantwortungsvoll und
vielseitig – Ihr Aufgabenfeld Your Mission You will lead our
European Sales organization to success, both strategically and
operationally, with a strong focus on customer retention, growth, and
innovation. As a member of our leadership team, you will actively
shape the future of chemical logistics, further develop our sales
organization, and set benchmarks in a dynamic market environment. Your
Key Responsibilities Strategy: Develop and implement long-term sales

Actively manage our customer portfolio, particularly strategic key
accounts, and establish a value-based customer management approach.

focus on performance, professional growth, and our corporate values.

agreements and implement standards for commercial terms, conditions,
and compliance. Process Optimization: Continuously improve our sales

jobs.occupation: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Einkauf und Logistik)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Global Procurement Specialist / Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) Are
you ready to secure the supply chain for Europe’s pioneer
semiconductor Greenfield project? As a Global Procurement Specialist /
Strategic Buyer, you will take ownership of the commercial end-to-end
sourcing process for critical materials supporting our brand-new
manufacturing site in Dresden. You will negotiate high-volume global
contracts, mitigate supply chain risks, and build resilient
partnerships with key international suppliers. If you thrive at the
intersection of business strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and
high-tech operations, this role offers you the ultimate platform to
make a global impact. Tasks Strategic Sourcing: Develop, negotiate,
and execute end-to-end global sourcing strategies and contracts to
ensure a highly resilient, cost-effective supply of critical
materials. Supplier Partnership Management: Build and nurture
long-term strategic relationships with a global supplier base to
secure high-quality materials and services. Commercial Negotiation:
Lead commercial negotiations, drive total cost of ownership (TCO)
optimization, and actively manage commercial risks. Performance
Monitoring : Evaluate and manage supplier performance against key
quality, delivery, cost, and risk metrics to ensure full contract
compliance. Risk & Supply Resilience: Proactively identify and resolve
supplier-related issues, including delivery disruptions and quality
deviations, using data-driven preventive actions. Cross-Functional
Alignment: Collaborate closely with engineering, fab operations,
finance, and HQ procurement teams to align sourcing activities with
production budgets and timelines. Process Excellence: Contribute to
continuous improvement initiatives to streamline procurement workflows
and scale up supply chain operations. Governance & ESG: Ensure strict
compliance with all internal policies, contractual obligations, trade
laws, and ESG standards across all purchasing activities. Profile
Required: Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Supply Chain
Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, IT, or a
related field. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of strategic procurement
or supply chain experience within an international industrial setting.
Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in commercial negotiations,
contract management, and strategic supplier evaluation. Languages:
Proficiency in English (C1) and German (C1) is required for seamless
collaboration with local and global stakeholders. Mindset: Strong
analytical thinking, attention to detail in contract review, and the
ability to coordinate multiple complex projects simultaneously.
International Onboarding: Willingness to complete an intensive
training of 3-6 months at TSMC Taiwan. Nice to have: Industry
Knowledge: Prior experience in the semiconductor, chemical, or
advanced materials industry. Certifications: Professional supply chain
or procurement certifications (e.g., APICS CPIM/CSCP, ISM CPSM).
Global Mindset: Experience in collaborating with Asian business
environments; Mandarin language skills are a plus. Why Join ESMC? Help
build a completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe.
Work in a highly international environment with colleagues across the
world. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
Additional contact details Please apply with an English resume.

Your job at DKV Mobility? As part of a leading European B2B platform
for on-the-road payment solutions, you will work in an exciting
environment. Our tasks are defined by our Purpose: To drive the
transition towards an efficient and sustainable future of mobility. We
offer you numerous opportunities to help shape the mobility of
tomorrow in a dynamic and agile environment. Our approximately 2,700
employees throughout Europe are united by a common passion: to give

to our claim: You drive, we care. Become part of our diverse,
dedicated and unique team! What you can expect Do you want to play an
active role in driving a company’s growth and turning big plans into
reality? Then join our team! You can look forward to exciting
challenges, an inspiring environment, and a work culture that combines
flexibility and collaboration – with our 60/40 hybrid model and
modern offices in Ratingen as a hub for ideas. As part of our team,
you will take on the following responsibilities: You analyze the
existing system, infrastructure, and CMDB landscape and develop

What makes you stand out You hold a degree in Computer Science,
Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification in the IT field.
You have several years of experience designing, operating, and

criticality, risk, and protection requirements. You have a strong
understanding of the interdependencies between IT architecture, CMDB,
asset inventory management, CIAA classification, security
requirements, and compliance frameworks. You are familiar with
industry standards and frameworks such as ITIL, ISMS, as well as
regulatory requirements including NIS2 and DORA. Ideally, you have
experience managing external service providers and collaborating
across various IT functions. You work in a structured, analytical, and
solution-oriented manner and possess strong consulting and
communication skills. Fluent German and very good English skills
complete your profile. We are looking forward to your application and
to applicants who enrich our diverse culture! Regardless of age,
gender, origin and sexual identity and orientation. Severely disabled

jobs.occupation: Solution Designer (m/f/d) (IT-Projektkoordinator/in)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

You make complex industrial processes understandable, efficient, and scalable.

As a Business Process & UX Architect, you ensure that our digital products not only function technically, but are also intuitive to use, minimize errors, and create real value for users.

Your focus: clarifying processes, reducing complexity, and shortening time to value.

Your Responsibilities

- You translate complex business, diagnostic, and service processes into clear software and workflow concepts
- You identify automation potential and improve workflows for our users
- You design consistent system logic around services, SLAs, roles, and permissions
- You develop intuitive user journeys with a strong focus on usability and user adoption
- You work closely with Product Management, UX, and Development teams
- You support product development through clear documentation, communication, and user feedback

Your Profile

- Degree in Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Human‑Computer Interaction (HCI), or a comparable technical field
- Experience in business process design, UX or system architecture, or product concept development
- Experience working with product management and agile development teams (Scrum)
- Very good understanding of B2B software, industrial applications, or IoT platforms
- Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly, structured, and user‑oriented
- Very good English skills, both written and spoken

Nice to Have

- Experience with industrial software, IoT platforms, or technical B2B products
- Knowledge of machine diagnostics, condition monitoring, or service processes
- Experience with process and UX tools (e.g., BPMN, Figma, Confluence, Jira)
- Interest in AI‑supported process or workflow automation

What We Offer

- A strategically important role at the intersection of product, technology, and user experience
- Significant creative freedom in shaping processes, UX concepts, and system logic
- An international environment with short decision‑making paths

Our Promise

- Flexible working hours and the option to work from home
- Attractive compensation, including tax‑free benefits (e.g., Sodexo meal vouchers and fuel vouchers)
- Height‑adjustable desks in small offices (2–3 people)
- Strong commitment to sustainability (solar power, waste separation, orchard meadow, etc.)
- Bicycle leasing via BusinessBike
- Table soccer and table tennis for breaks

Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We work together to ensure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Across Europe we have more than 50 Fulfillment Centers, hundreds of Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and tens of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time. Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. - Work with the site Safety department & Site Leadership to implement, record and audit safety and statutory compliance programs to provide a safe working environment for all staff. Own the legal responsibilities as the site engineering lead within this framework.
